classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 44 supplies open endpoints and infinite rays; page 49 supplies union.

content.prompt:
Sketch the following on a number line.
$(-1,1)\cup[1,\infty)$

answer.worked:
$1$ is included in the second interval, so there is no gap at $1$.
$$(-1,1)\cup[1,\infty)=(-1,\infty).$$
Use an open endpoint at $-1$ and a ray to the right.

spec.description: Open endpoint at −1 and rightward ray above a numbered axis.
